label: VALIDATION_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD
definition: A Validation Test, applied to a SingleRecord, that evaluates: Does the value of dwc:occurrenceStatus occur in the bdqval:sourceAuthority? It returns: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:occurrenceStatus is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:occurrenceStatus is resolved in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT. It uses the following default authority and/or parameter values: Regex present/absent. Its behavior can be altered by the following parameter(s): bdqval:sourceAuthority.
description: Does the value of dwc:occurrenceStatus occur in the bdqval:sourceAuthority?
notes: The recommended controlled vocabulary for this term consists of "present" and "absent", which are the only two appropriate terms for a Darwin Core Occurrence. This is reflected in the dwc:occurrenceStatus vocabulary for this Test. There is currently a mismatch between the (authoritative) lower case values at https://dwc.tdwg.org/terms/#dwc:occurrenceStatus and the vocabulary at GBIF (https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/OccurrenceStatus/concepts), which capitalized the first character. This Test must return NOT_COMPLIANT if there are case differences, leading or trailing whitespace or there are leading or trailing non-printing characters.
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:occurrenceStatus is bdqval:Empty; COMPLIANT if the value of dwc:occurrenceStatus is resolved in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_COMPLIANT
examples: [dwc:occurrenceStatus="present": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:occurrenceStatus matches a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"],[dwc:occurrenceStatus="presence": Response.status=RUN_HAS_RESULT, Response.result=NOT_COMPLIANT, Response.comment="dwc:occurrenceStatus does not match a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"]

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_QA_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD
prefLabel: Measurement over MultiRecord for QualityAssurance of Validation dwc:occurrenceStatus Standard
definition: A Measure, applied to a MultiRecord, that evaluates for quality assurance: Measure if all VALIDATION_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD in a record set are COMPLIANT. It returns: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE. It is based on the aggregated outcomes of the Test(s): VALIDATION_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD.
description: Measure if all VALIDATION_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD in a record set are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Assurance, filter record set until this measure is COMPLETE.
expectedResponse: COMPLETE if every VALIDATION_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD in the MultiRecord has Response.result=COMPLIANT; otherwise NOT_COMPLETE.
references: Veiga AK, Saraiva AM, Chapman AD, Morris PJ, Gendreau C, Schigel D, Robertson TJ (2017). A conceptual framework for quality assessment and management of biodiversity data. PLOS ONE 12(6): e0178731. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0178731

label: MULTIRECORD_MEASURE_COUNT_COMPLIANT_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD

description: Count the number of VALIDATION_OCCURRENCESTATUS_STANDARD in a record set that are COMPLIANT.
notes: For Quality Control, compare the Response.result of this measure with the total number of records to assess work needed on the record set.
